newsitem.title: JAPAN: ITJ denies report on acquisition by Japan Telecom.
newsitem.headline: ITJ denies report on acquisition by Japan Telecom.

text.p: International Telecom Japan Inc (ITJ) denied a newspaper report on Thursday that it was to be acquired by Japan Telecom Co Ltd.
"We deny the report. There is no such fact. There is no agreement and we are not negotiating (over one)," an ITJ spokewoman said.

The Japanese daily Sankei Shimbun reported on Thursday that Japan Telecom, a long-distance telecommunications operator, and ITJ, which offers international telecommunications services, had agreed that Japan Telecom would acquire ITJ as early as October for 80 billion yen.
Japan Telecom officials were not immediately available for comment.

But earlier this week, Japan Telecom director Taro Sasaki told a news conference that the company was planning to launch international telecommunications services in the spring of 1998 by connecting its lines with those of Japanese international carriers.
He said that Japan Telecom was talking with three international carriers -- Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd, IDC Corp and ITJ -- about conditions for using each other's lines.
